page.layout: One page of text in one column. Running head at top, page number at top right. Right margin carries small « marks beside the lines.

main_text.p: men referatur:cum fatis co-stet,non artis alicuius,sed de orum sacerdotes dici con-sueuisse. Utcunque fit, Iuris-consultos Romae huic muneri praecipuè praefuisse, Ci-cero quoq; libro de arte Rhetorica II his docet uerbis:Status negotialis est, inquit, in quo quid iuris ex ciuili more & æquitate fit, cōsideratur: cui diligentiæ præesse apud nos Iurisconsulti existiman-tur. Multo uero planius Po-ponius nofter, in L.2. de O-rig.Iuris,ubi sic scribit: His legibus latis coepit,ut naturali-ter euenire solet, ut interpretatio desideraret prudentiū aucto-

page.notes: Small « marks in the right margin beside the lines are quotation-continuation signs, not printed words, so they are not transcribed. "praecipuè" carries a grave-like mark; read as printed. "Sta-tus", "Rhe-torica", "le-gibus" and "interpre-tatio" are split across lines without a printed hyphen, so they are written whole. "exiftiman-" and "naturali-" keep their printed hyphens. Line-end "aucto-" is a broken word continued on the next page. No catchword is printed.
